parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('{{ $json.escapedEmail }}')) AS email_count,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN id ~ '^EMP-[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(id FROM 5) AS INT) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS max_emp_num
FROM employees;

nodes.name: Postgres - Check Email Exists & Next ID

parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS personal_email VARCHAR(255);

INSERT INTO employees (
  id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  email,
  personal_email,
  password_hash,
  phone,
  designation,
  joining_date,
  employment_type,
  work_location,
  role,
  salary,
  is_active
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.employeeId }}',
  '{{ $json.firstName }}',
  '{{ $json.lastName }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.personalEmail }}', ''),
  crypt('{{ $json.rawPassword }}', gen_salt('bf', 8)),
  '{{ $json.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.designation }}',
  '{{ $json.joiningDate }}'::DATE,
  '{{ $json.employmentType }}',
  '{{ $json.workLocation }}',
  '{{ $json.role }}',
  {{ $json.salary }},
  TRUE
);

INSERT INTO leave_balances (employee_id, leave_type, year, label, total, used) VALUES\n  ('{{ $json.employeeId }}', 'CASUAL', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Casual Leave', 12.0, 0.0),\n  ('{{ $json.employeeId }}', 'SICK', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Sick Leave', 5.0, 0.0)\nON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.first_name AS "firstName",
  e.last_name AS "lastName",
  e.email,
  e.personal_email AS "personalEmail",
  e.phone,
  e.designation,
  e.joining_date::TEXT AS "joiningDate",
  e.employment_type AS "employmentType",
  e.work_location AS "workLocation",
  e.role,
  e.salary::FLOAT AS salary,
  e.is_active AS "isActive"
FROM employees e
WHERE e.id = '{{ $json.employeeId }}'
LIMIT 1;
